student_will_learn: Explain what AWS Config does and how Config Rules detect non-compliant resources
Configure auto-remediation for a Config Rule using a Lambda function
Explain what Trusted Advisor checks and its five categories of recommendations
Set up a Config Rule to continuously monitor for a specific compliance requirement
Identify the cost of ignoring Trusted Advisor findings over time

ava_lesson_intro.ava_speaks: இதுவரைக்கும் நாம metrics, logs, alarms, audit trails பார்த்தோம் - இதெல்லாம் 'ஏதோ தப்பா நடந்துடுச்சு'nு தெரிஞ்சுக்க உதவும். இப்போ Deepak Menon-ஓட FQ-203 ticket-ல கடைசி கேள்வி - 'ஏதோ தப்பா நடக்கறதுக்கு முன்னாடியே, resources correctly configure பண்ணப்பட்டிருக்கானு continuously verify பண்ண முடியுமா?' இதுதான் இன்னைக்கு நாம கத்துக்கப் போற AWS Config மற்றும் Trusted Advisor - இதுகூட CS6 Monitoring-ஓட கடைசி lesson.

lines: Building Basics · Session CS6 · Lesson C6.4
Ticket FQ-203 — closing out with Deepak Menon

blocks.ava_speaks: AWS Config, account-ல இருக்கற resources-ஓட configuration state-ஐ continuously track பண்ணும் - ஒரு resource எப்போ create ஆச்சு, என்ன மாறுச்சு, தற்போது என்ன state-ல இருக்கு. Config Rules, ஒரு specific compliance condition define பண்ணும் (example: 'எல்லா S3 buckets-மும் encryption enabled-ஆ இருக்கணும்') - Config, ஒவ்வொரு resource-ஐயும் இந்த rule-கூட continuously evaluate பண்ணும், non-compliant resources-ஐ flag பண்ணும். Auto-remediation, ஒரு Lambda function-ஐ trigger பண்ணி, non-compliant resource-ஐ automatic-ஆ fix பண்ணும் - manual intervention தேவை இல்லாம.

rows: Non-compliant resources discovered only during manual audits
Non-compliant resources flagged continuously, in near real-time
Fixing a violation requires someone to notice and act manually
Auto-remediation (via Lambda) can fix the violation automatically

board_actions.text: Config Rules answer 'is my account currently compliant with our own rules?' continuously — not just at the moment of an audit.

inline_questions.question: FoodQuick-க்கு 'எல்லா S3 buckets-மும் Block Public Access enabled-ஆ இருக்கணும்' compliance rule இருக்கு. Config Rule இதை எப்படி enforce பண்ணும்?
options: A) Config Rule ஒரே ஒரு தடவை check பண்ணி, forget பண்ணிடும்
B) Config Rule continuously evaluate பண்ணும், non-compliant bucket கண்டா flag பண்ணும் (optionally auto-remediate பண்ணும்)
C) Config Rules S3-கூட வேலை செய்யாது
D) Manual-ஆ ஒவ்வொரு நாளும் யாராவது check பண்ணனும்
inline_questions.ava_correct: Correct! Config Rules continuously evaluate பண்ணும் - ஒரு bucket எப்போ non-compliant ஆனாலும், அது immediately flag ஆகும், auto-remediation configure பண்ணி இருந்தா, automatic-ஆ fix-மும் ஆகும்.
inline_questions.ava_wrong: இல்ல, Config Rules ஒரு one-time check இல்ல - அது continuously monitor பண்ணும். ஒரு resource எப்போ non-compliant state-க்கு மாறுதோ, உடனே அது detect ஆகும்.

inline_questions.question: Auto-remediation-ஓட role என்ன Config Rules-ல?
options: A) Non-compliant resources-ஐ automatic-ஆ delete பண்ணும்
B) Non-compliant resources-ஐ, Lambda function trigger பண்ணி, automatic-ஆ compliant state-க்கு fix பண்ணும்
C) Compliance check-ஐ முழுசா disable பண்ணும்
D) Config Rules-ல auto-remediation option இல்லவே இல்ல
inline_questions.ava_correct: Sari! Auto-remediation, resource-ஐ delete பண்ணாது - அது ஒரு Lambda function trigger பண்ணி, resource-ஐ correct, compliant configuration-க்கு automatic-ஆ மாற்றும்.
inline_questions.ava_wrong: இல்ல, auto-remediation delete பண்ணாது - அது ஒரு configured Lambda function வழியா, resource-ஐ correct state-க்கு fix பண்ணும், manual intervention இல்லாம.

blocks.block_title: Six Months of Ignored Trusted Advisor Findings
blocks.ava_speaks: Trusted Advisor, AWS-ஓட built-in advisor tool - Cost Optimization, Security, Fault Tolerance, Performance, Service Limits ஆகிய 5 categories-ல, recommendations தொடர்ந்து தரும். FoodQuick-ஓட ஒரு prior review-ல கண்டுபிடிச்சது - Trusted Advisor, 6 மாசமா, idle load balancers, unattached EBS volumes, over-provisioned instances பத்தி flag பண்ணிட்டே இருந்துச்சு - யாரும் அதை படிக்கவே இல்ல. Total accumulated waste, ஒரு significant amount-ஆ இருந்துச்சு. Freshworks மாதிரி companies, Trusted Advisor findings-ஐ monthly review cadence-ல தான் actively act பண்றாங்க, dashboard-ல வெறுமனே sit பண்ண விடாம.

rows: Idle load balancers, unattached EBS volumes still being billed
Security groups with unrestricted access, MFA not enabled on root
Over-utilized instances that should be resized up
Approaching an account's service quota for a resource type

blocks.block_title: Setting Up a Config Rule With Auto-Remediation
blocks.ava_speaks: karthik-dev இப்போ, S3 buckets-ல encryption enforce பண்ண ஒரு Config Rule set பண்றான், auto-remediation-கூட.

steps.ava_narration: AWS Config Console-ல 'Rules' -> 'Add rule' click பண்றோம், AWS managed rule 's3-bucket-server-side-encryption-enabled' தேடி select பண்றோம்.

console_action.path: AWS Config Console → Rules → Add rule
console_action.highlight: s3-bucket-server-side-encryption-enabled rule in the managed rules list
console_action.result: This pre-built rule checks whether every S3 bucket has default encryption enabled

steps.ava_narration: Rule scope-ஆ 'All S3 buckets in this account' select பண்றோம், rule create பண்றோம்.

console_action.result: Config begins continuously evaluating every S3 bucket in the account against this rule

steps.ava_narration: இப்போ auto-remediation configure பண்றோம் - 'Manage remediation' click பண்ணி, action-ஆ 'AWS-EnableS3BucketEncryption' Systems Manager Automation document select பண்றோம்.

console_action.result: Any bucket found non-compliant will automatically have encryption enabled, without manual intervention

steps.ava_narration: 'Auto remediation' toggle ON பண்றோம். இப்போ ஒரு engineer, தப்பா ஒரு un-encrypted bucket create பண்ணா, Config automatic-ஆ கண்டுபிடிச்சு, encryption-ஐ automatic-ஆ enable பண்ணிடும்.

console_action.highlight: Auto remediation toggle switched to ON
console_action.result: Non-compliant buckets are now automatically fixed as soon as Config detects them, closing the gap between violation and correction

steps.ava_narration: Trusted Advisor Console-ல போய், Cost Optimization category-ல findings review பண்றோம் - idle load balancers மற்றும் unattached EBS volumes flag ஆகி இருக்கு.

console_action.highlight: Flagged idle load balancers and unattached volumes
console_action.result: A clear, actionable list of cost-saving opportunities is visible, ready for the team to act on

expected_outcome.description: S3 encryption is now continuously enforced with automatic remediation, and Trusted Advisor's cost findings are visible for the team to act on rather than sitting unreviewed.
expected_outcome.what_to_notice: Config Rule proactive-ஆ prevent பண்ணுது (structural guardrail), Trusted Advisor findings-க்கு இன்னும் human action தேவை - அதை review பண்ணாம விட்டா, useless-ஆ இருக்கும்.

blocks.block_title: Config Continuous Monitoring vs Trusted Advisor Periodic Recommendations
blocks.ava_speaks: இந்த diagram பாரு - Config-க்கும் Trusted Advisor-க்கும் உள்ள complementary roles.

ascii: Resource created/changed -> Config evaluates against rules IMMEDIATELY
Non-compliant? -> Flag + optional auto-remediation, within minutes
Findings accumulate on a dashboard -> REQUIRES a human to review and act

output_preview.ava_narration: Config real-time-ல, automatic-ஆ enforce பண்ணும். Trusted Advisor, recommendations தரும், ஆனா act பண்றது இன்னும் team responsibility தான்.

blocks.block_title: Your Turn — Create a Config Rule for a Security Requirement
blocks.instruction: FoodQuick-ஓட security policy-ப்படி, எந்த Security Group-லும் port 22 (SSH), 0.0.0.0/0-க்கு open-ஆ இருக்கக்கூடாது. இதை continuously enforce பண்ண ஒரு Config Rule set பண்ணு.
blocks.scenario: C3.4-ல நாம port 22 open to the world-ஐ ஒரு critical mistake-ஆ கத்துக்கிட்டோம். Deepak Menon, இதை ஒரு manual review-ஆ இல்லாம, continuous, automatic-ஆ enforce பண்ண வேணும்னு request பண்ணி இருக்காங்க.

starter_state.console_open: AWS Config Console → Rules → Add rule
starter_state.current_configuration: No rule currently monitors for open SSH access

requirements: Select the AWS managed rule 'restricted-ssh' (or equivalent, checking for port 22 open to 0.0.0.0/0)
Scope the rule to all Security Groups in the account
Decide whether to enable auto-remediation or leave it as detection-only, with reasoning
If auto-remediation is chosen, select an appropriate remediation action that removes the offending rule
hints: AWS managed rules-ல, 'restricted-ssh' மாதிரி பேரு வெச்சு ready-made rules இருக்கும் - custom rule எழுத வேண்டியதே இல்ல பொதுவான cases-க்கு

Auto-remediation decision-ஐ யோசி - ஒரு legitimate business reason-க்காக யாராவது intentionally port 22 open பண்ணி இருந்தா (rare, ஆனா possible), auto-remediation அதையும் revert பண்ணிடும், அதனால இது ஒரு real trade-off
Detection-only தேர்ந்தெடுத்தாலும், அது still valuable - team-க்கு உடனே தெரியப்படுத்தும், manual review பண்ணி decide பண்ணலாம்

expected_outcome.verifiable_result: A Config rule scoped to all Security Groups checks for port 22 open to 0.0.0.0/0, with a clearly reasoned decision on auto-remediation vs detection-only
expected_outcome.ava_correct: Correct! இப்போ இந்த critical security mistake, C3.4-ல நாம பார்த்தது மாதிரி, ஒரு போதும் unnoticed-ஆ இருக்காது - Config continuously watch பண்ணிட்டே இருக்கும்.
expected_outcome.ava_wrong: Rule scope-ஐ ஒரு தடவை check பண்ணு - எல்லா Security Groups-மும் cover ஆகுதா, port 22-ஐ specifically target பண்றதா-ன்னு பாரு.

blocks.block_title: The Cost Findings Nobody Ever Looked At
blocks.ava_speaks: ananya-analyst, ஒரு quarterly cost review பண்றப்போ, Trusted Advisor-ல ஒரு shocking discovery பண்றாங்க - Cost Optimization category-ல, 6 மாசமா, தொடர்ந்து flag ஆகிட்டே இருந்த findings, ஒரு போதும் review பண்ணப்படவே இல்ல.
blocks.setup: FoodQuick's Trusted Advisor dashboard has been flagging several idle load balancers (created for a discontinued feature, never deleted) and multiple unattached EBS volumes (leftover from terminated instances where 'Delete on Termination' wasn't set) for 6 consecutive months, with no one on the team ever reviewing the Cost Optimization tab.
blocks.what_happened: By the time ananya-analyst discovers this during a routine quarterly review, the accumulated wasted spend on resources that provide zero business value has grown into a substantial, entirely avoidable line item — money that could have been saved with a 10-minute monthly check.
blocks.broken_config:
Trusted Advisor Cost Optimization findings (as of the review):
- 3 idle Application Load Balancers, no healthy targets for 6+ months
- 7 unattached EBS volumes, orphaned from terminated instances
- 2 instances flagged as significantly over-provisioned for their actual usage

Review cadence: none established — findings only surfaced when ananya-analyst happened to open the dashboard
blocks.error_shown: Trusted Advisor summary: estimated monthly savings available: a substantial recurring amount, flagged and unchanged for 180+ days.
blocks.the_real_problem: Trusted Advisor findings, automatic-ஆ act ஆகாது - அது ஒரு recommendation, action இல்ல. ஒரு explicit review process இல்லாம, findings dashboard-ல accumulate பண்ணிட்டே இருக்கும், யாரும் பார்க்காம. இது Config Rules-ல இருந்து ஒரு key difference - Trusted Advisor-க்கு human follow-through தேவை.

fix.corrected_config:
1. Immediately act on the current findings — delete idle load balancers, clean up unattached volumes, right-size over-provisioned instances.
2. Establish a mandatory monthly Trusted Advisor review as part of the team's standing process, with findings assigned to specific owners for action, not just passively viewed.
fix.result: The immediate waste is eliminated, and the new monthly cadence prevents future findings from silently accumulating for months again.

blocks.lesson: Trusted Advisor findings, dashboard-ல sit பண்ணி இருந்தா, அது எந்த value-மும் தராது - ஒரு explicit, recurring review process இல்லாம, valuable recommendations, months-கணக்கான avoidable waste-ஆ சும்மா தேங்கி நிற்கும்.

blocks.block_title: Judgment Round — Config and Trusted Advisor Decisions

challenges.question: A team enables auto-remediation on a Config Rule that automatically terminates any EC2 instance without a required 'owner' tag. What's a risk of blanket auto-remediation like this, versus detection-only?
challenges.answer: Auto-remediation that TERMINATES a resource is much higher-risk than one that simply fixes a configuration setting (like enabling encryption) — if a legitimate, business-critical instance briefly lacks the tag due to a launch process gap, it could be destroyed automatically with no human review, causing real damage. Detection-only (or a remediation that just alerts/quarantines rather than destroys) is often safer for high-impact actions.

challenges.question: Does AWS Config replace the need for Trusted Advisor, since Config can also flag non-compliant resources?
challenges.answer: No — they serve different purposes. Config checks resources against rules YOU define (custom compliance requirements specific to your organization). Trusted Advisor provides AWS's own broader best-practice recommendations across cost, security, performance, fault tolerance, and service limits, based on general AWS expertise, not your custom rules. Most mature setups use both.

challenges.question: A company has zero Config Rules and zero Trusted Advisor review process, but does have CloudWatch alarms and CloudTrail logging. Is their monitoring coverage complete?
challenges.answer: No — alarms and CloudTrail are reactive (something already happened, or a threshold was already breached) and investigative (after-the-fact tracing). Config and Trusted Advisor add a proactive, preventive layer — catching misconfigurations and waste before they cause an incident or accumulate cost, which alarms and CloudTrail alone don't provide.

blocks.block_title: How Teams Build a Complete Preventive Monitoring Practice
blocks.ava_speaks: Real companies-ல, Deepak Menon மாதிரி DevOps leads, Config மற்றும் Trusted Advisor-ஐ, ஒரு complete monitoring strategy-ஓட proactive layer-ஆ treat பண்றாங்க - reactive alarms மட்டும் இல்லாம.

workflow_steps.action: Define a core set of Config Rules covering the organization's non-negotiable security and compliance requirements, with auto-remediation for low-risk, high-confidence fixes
workflow_steps.detail: இது C3.4, C5.2 மாதிரி lessons-ல கத்துக்கிட்ட mistakes-ஐ, structural-ஆ ஒரு போதும் repeat ஆகாதுனு உறுதி பண்ணும்

workflow_steps.action: Schedule a recurring (monthly, at minimum) Trusted Advisor review with specific findings assigned to specific owners
workflow_steps.detail: இது ananya-analyst-ஓட 6-month discovery மாதிரி silent accumulation-ஐ தடுக்கும்

workflow_steps.action: Combine Config compliance status and Trusted Advisor findings into the same team dashboard used for CloudWatch metrics (from C6.1), giving one unified view of system health
workflow_steps.detail: இது monitoring-ஐ, தனித்தனி tools-ஆ இல்லாம, ஒரு single, cohesive practice-ஆ ஆக்கும்

tools_shown.use: பல related Config Rules-ஐ, ஒரு single, reusable package-ஆ deploy பண்ண உதவும் - example: ஒரு complete 'PCI compliance' rule set

tools_shown.tool: AWS Trusted Advisor Priority (via AWS Organizations)
tools_shown.use: Multi-account organizations-ல, most critical Trusted Advisor findings-ஐ centrally prioritize பண்ணி, தொலைஞ்சு போகாம track பண்ண உதவும்

lesson_summary.ava_speaks: Super! இன்னைக்கு நாம AWS Config, Config Rules, auto-remediation, Trusted Advisor-ஓட 5 categories எல்லாம் கத்துக்கிட்டோம். மிக முக்கியமா, Trusted Advisor findings review பண்ணாம விட்டா, months-கணக்கான avoidable waste accumulate ஆகும்னு உறுதியா கத்துக்கிட்ட. இதுகூட CS6 Monitoring முடிஞ்சிடுச்சு - metrics, logs, alarms, audit trails, compliance monitoring வரைக்கும் full observability foundation கட்டிட்டோம். Deepak Menon-ஓட FQ-203 ticket-ஓட phase complete. அடுத்த session-ல நாம CS7-க்கு போவோம் - Building Basics-ஓட கடைசி session, FoodQuick-ஓட முழு architecture-ஐயும் design பண்றது.

board.title: Lesson C6.4 — Summary
points: ✓ AWS Config continuously evaluates resources against defined rules, flagging non-compliance in near real-time
✓ Auto-remediation uses a Lambda function to automatically fix non-compliant resources without manual intervention
✓ Trusted Advisor provides recommendations across 5 categories: Cost Optimization, Security, Fault Tolerance, Performance, and Service Limits
✓ Trusted Advisor findings require human review and action — they don't self-remediate like Config Rules can
✓ Ignoring Trusted Advisor findings for months lets avoidable cost and risk silently accumulate
